meta_description: The simplest way to get NTMPI tokens. Swap ETH, USDC, or any ERC-20 token for NTMPI directly — no account needed, no middleman.
hero_subtitle: Swap any ERC-20 token for NTMPI directly from your wallet. No signup. No middleman. Powered by Uniswap.
swap_note: Connect your Ethereum wallet (MetaMask, Rabby, etc.) to swap. The widget routes through Uniswap for the best available rate.
info_p1: NTMPI is the native token of the Neutaro blockchain, powering the Timpi decentralized search engine ecosystem. It's used for governance, validator staking, node rewards, and payments within the Timpi data marketplace.
info_p2: The ERC-20 version of NTMPI on Ethereum can be bridged to the native Neutaro chain via OraiDEX for staking and governance participation.
other_ways_mexc: Trade NTMPI/USDT on MEXC — supports credit card, bank transfer, Apple Pay, and P2P.
other_ways_oraidex: Swap cross-chain on OraiDEX — bridge directly to the native Neutaro chain.
other_ways_staking: After acquiring NTMPI, delegate to Neutaro validators for ~17% APR staking rewards.
bridge_p1: The swap widget delivers ERC-20 NTMPI on Ethereum. To use NTMPI for staking, governance, or node operations, bridge your tokens to the native Neutaro chain:
bridge_step2: Connect your Ethereum wallet and Keplr/OWallet
bridge_step3: Bridge NTMPI from Ethereum → Oraichain → Neutaro
bridge_step4: Delegate to validators in the Neutaro Explorer
